output.summary: A flowering herbaceous perennial found across temperate Europe, Asia and eastern and western North America. It bears feathery plumes of white or cream flowers, with male and female flowers on separate plants. In Italy, young shoots are briefly boiled and then cooked with eggs and cheese or added to a wild-green soup.
